literal_meaning: গঙ্গা নদীর প্রাপ্তি বা লাভ (attainment or gain of the Ganges River)
figurative_meaning_en: death; final moments; death on the banks of the Ganges
example_sentences_in_bangla: বুড়ো মানুষটির গঙ্গাপ্রাপ্তির পর পরিবার শোকাহত।
example_sentences_in_english: He attained the Ganga last night.
The old man's attainment of the Ganga left the family in mourning.
history: In Hindu tradition, dying on the banks of the sacred Ganges River is believed to grant immediate moksha (liberation from the cycle of rebirth), making this idiom a euphemism for death with spiritual connotations.
note: The idiom reflects the deep reverence for the Ganges in Bengali Hindu culture.
